title: A writer's task closes on its own work: the plugin's own state is never refused at commit, and an out-of-scope edit becomes a note instead of a refusal
description: Fixes from the stage 1 confirming measurement; the writer's prompt stays equal to plain's.
desiredOutcome: A task whose gate is green commits even when the plugin itself wrote a restore point, and a writer edit outside the task's files is left out of the commit and named, so the measured pipeline can finish a task.

tasks.title: commit-task-work never refuses the plugin's own state - the manifest restore point under audit-backups/ and the .gitignore line that hides it - and one table of plugin-owned paths is read by both the writer and the check
tasks.description: Register F782. Stage 1 run a2: the gate was green and commit-task-work's undeclared-path refusal (attempt_refusal, commit-task-work.py ~546) refused twice on paths no session created by a tool call: `.claude/.gitignore` gaining `audit-backups/`, then `audit-backups/audit-plan.json.bak-<stamp>`. The writers of those paths are in manifest/_manifest_io.py and migrate-manifest.py (grep audit-backups). Put the plugin-owned state paths (restore points, the .gitignore entry the plugin adds, its state dirs) in one table in a shared module both read; attempt_refusal treats them as plugin-owned: never refused as the task's edit, never silently left out of the record (name them on a line). Check the owner's earlier report of the same class: `.claude/audit.config.json` created mid-attempt was refused too (register F760) - cover it by the same table if it belongs there.

add: tests/test_commit_task_work.py: a task whose attempt left the plugin's restore point under audit-backups/ and the .gitignore line for it commits its own files and names the plugin-owned paths it did not refuse, while an undeclared edit to an ordinary source file is still refused

tasks.title: On the writer path, an edit outside the task's declared files is left out of the commit and named, instead of refusing the whole task
tasks.description: Register F783. Stage 1 runs a1 and a1b: the writer (plain prompt, which states no scope) edited PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, which the task does not declare; commit-task-work refused the whole task. The writer prompt must stay equal to plain's, so the fix belongs in the drive: on the writer path (executor.writerModel set), before the commit, the drive reverts each undeclared changed path in the task tree after saving it as a patch under the run's state, records a task note naming each path and the patch, re-proves/re-gates if any reverted path was read by the gate, then commits the declared work. Leave the subagent-executor path unchanged (it keeps refusing). Plugin-owned paths (the table from the sibling task) are never reverted.

add: tests/test_drive_phase.py: a writer session that also edited an undeclared file has that file reverted and saved as a named patch, a note names it, and the task commits its declared work; the same edit on the executor path is still refused

request: Stage 1 measurement (2026-10-22): runs could not close because the commit check refused the plugin's own restore point and the writer's out-of-scope edit (register F782, F783)
